headline: China reports manufacturing AI adoption indicators across 20 industries
summary: China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reported results from a year-long AI+Manufacturing action: more than 1,000 high-value use scenarios across 20 industries, 285 published application cases, more than 5,000 participating companies, and AI adoption penetration above 30% among above-scale manufacturing enterprises. The National Bureau of Statistics separately reported that AI application in key above-scale manufacturing scenarios exceeded one-third and that Q3 digital-product manufacturing value added grew 13.6% year over year. These are distinct official aggregates: neither account defines its adoption denominator here, and the output-growth figure is not attributed causally to AI. MIIT also reported over 500 high-quality datasets and more than 100 industrial agents across 20 key sectors. The accounts do not establish sustained deployment quality or productivity gains.
